Together, the bloc represents around 45% of the global population and over a third of global GDP, focusing on de-dollarization, local currency trade, and Global South cooperation. With key milestones like India hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in September 2026, the group continues to be a major force in reshaping international finance and geopolitics.
